justification: Pure transform: PageShellInput → { head, body } HTML strings.  Pure string concatenation with mandatory HTML-escaping of every user-supplied value and a URL-scheme allowlist that defeats `javascript:` injection.  The page's body field is the documented exception (pre-rendered HTML from upstream markdown renderer, trusted).  No eval, no Function, no JSON.parse-with-reviver, no fs/network/env/shell.  Zero runtime dependencies.
